comment: Authentication Policy Silos and Authentication Policies for Tier Model. Optional add-on — loaded only when -IncludeAuthSilos is specified. All objects are created in audit mode (enforce: false); enforcement is a separate lifecycle step gated on a pre-enforcement safety checklist. Both policies and silos are created with protectedFromAccidentalDeletion: true. Silos govern COMPUTER membership only — tier device groups (DCs, servers, PAWs, EUD) are enrolled at deploy time. Admin-account siloing is an out-of-band operator task; the Tier Model does not manage user silo membership.

authenticationPolicies.name: *- Tier 0 Admins Authentication Policy
authenticationPolicies.description: Authentication Policy for Tier 0 administrative accounts. Restricts Kerberos TGT issuance to approved Tier 0 origin devices, and lowers the Kerberos TGT lifetime to 2 hours (120 minutes).
authenticationPolicies.comment: 'Domain Controllers' and 'Read-only Domain Controllers' are built-in AD security groups. SDDL is NOT authored in this file — the deploy module resolves each group name to a SID at runtime and builds a Member_of_any (OR-logic) SDDL for AllowedToAuthenticateFrom.

authenticationPolicies.name: *- Tier 1 Admins Authentication Policy
authenticationPolicies.description: Authentication Policy for Tier 1 administrative accounts. Restricts Kerberos TGT issuance to approved Tier 1 origin devices, and lowers the Kerberos TGT lifetime to 4 hours (240 minutes).
authenticationPolicies.comment: SDDL is NOT authored in this file — the deploy module resolves group names to SIDs at runtime and builds a Member_of_any (OR-logic) SDDL for AllowedToAuthenticateFrom.

authenticationPolicies.name: *- Tier 2 Admins Authentication Policy
authenticationPolicies.description: Authentication Policy for Tier 2 administrative accounts. Restricts Kerberos TGT issuance to approved Tier 2 PAW devices, and lowers the Kerberos TGT lifetime to 6 hours (360 minutes).
authenticationPolicies.comment: SDDL is NOT authored in this file — the deploy module resolves the group name to a SID at runtime and builds a Member_of_any SDDL (the uniform OR-logic template is used even for single-group policies).

authenticationPolicies.name: *- Tier 2 EUD Authentication Policy
authenticationPolicies.description: Authentication Policy for Tier 2 End-User Device local device operators. Restricts Kerberos TGT issuance to approved Tier 2 EUD origin devices; the Kerberos TGT lifetime is not lowered here, so EUD accounts inherit the domain-default lifetime (about 10 hours).
authenticationPolicies.comment: userTGTLifetimeMinutes is null (confirmed): EUD local device operators intentionally inherit the domain-default Kerberos TGT lifetime. SDDL is NOT authored in this file — the deploy module resolves the group name to a SID at runtime and builds a Member_of_any SDDL.

authenticationSilos.name: *- Tier 0 Admins Authentication Silo
authenticationSilos.description: Authentication Policy Silo for Tier 0 administrators, operators, server operators, and service accounts. Silo members may only obtain Kerberos TGTs from approved Tier 0 devices.
authenticationSilos.comment: 'Domain Controllers' and 'Read-only Domain Controllers' in memberComputerGroups are built-in AD security groups (confirmed correct names). Admin-account siloing is an operator task outside TM scope.

authenticationSilos.name: *- Tier 1 Admins Authentication Silo
authenticationSilos.description: Authentication Policy Silo for Tier 1 administrators, operators, server operators, and service accounts. Silo members may only obtain Kerberos TGTs from approved Tier 1 devices.
authenticationSilos.comment: Admin-account siloing is an operator task outside TM scope.

authenticationSilos.name: *- Tier 2 Admins Authentication Silo
authenticationSilos.description: Authentication Policy Silo for Tier 2 administrators, operators, and service accounts. Silo members may only obtain Kerberos TGTs from approved Tier 2 PAW devices.
authenticationSilos.comment: Admin-account siloing is an operator task outside TM scope.

authenticationSilos.name: *- Tier 2 EUD Authentication Silo
authenticationSilos.description: Authentication Policy Silo for Tier 2 End-User Device local device operators. Silo members may only obtain Kerberos TGTs from approved Tier 2 EUD devices.
authenticationSilos.comment: EUD local device operators are siloed by computer group (Tier2EUDDevices); account siloing is an operator task outside TM scope.
